mapper.select: select u.user_id from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id inner join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.role_id where u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and r.role_key = #{roleKey} order by u.user_id
select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = #{userId}
select r.role_key from sys_role r inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' order by r.role_sort
